areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Fleet electrification, energy-efficiency practices and carbon offsetting through reforestation show a robust environmental commitment.

areas.name: Energy efficiency and renewable energy
areas.reason: Advanced technologies and solar systems at the proponent's facilities reduce energy consumption.

areas.name: Biodiversity and forest resources
areas.reason: Carbon-offset planting with control of exotic species, pasture isolation, diverse planting, maintenance and monitoring.

areas.name: Individual entrepreneurs and micro/small firms
areas.reason: Management training for Black women micro-entrepreneurs and operational modernization widen their sales and distribution opportunities.

areas.name: Youth, gender and race policies
areas.reason: Gender and race strengthening through training of Black women micro-entrepreneurs, aimed at equity.

areas.name: Technological development, innovation and modernization
areas.reason: Clean technologies such as electromobility, operational automation and ICT advances show a clear modernization focus.

areas.name: Integrated water-resources management and water security
areas.reason: Water theme is not a central focus; no water indicator or specific objective, so soil and spring conservation is only a by-product.

areas.name: Business environment and opportunities
areas.reason: Lacks substantive, targeted measures; limited direct economic or regional development impact.

areas.name: Jobs and income for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Effects on low-income communities are indirect; no policy targeted by economic stratification.

areas.name: Infrastructure and social facilities for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: No specific infrastructure or social facility actions.

areas.name: Inclusion of social minorities
areas.reason: No specific measures for including social minorities.

areas.name: Public-service delivery, management and citizen participation
areas.reason: No evidence of improved or innovative service delivery, management or participation.

areas.name: Education and health conditions
areas.reason: No initiatives aimed specifically at education or health.

areas.name: Financing arrangements encouraging private participation
areas.reason: No financing arrangements such as PPPs; programme centres on the proponent's own modernization and ecological transformation.
